verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is a payments/authentication and trusted-agent-verification layer (tokenization, mandates, passkeys, Trusted Agent Protocol signatures) — none of the evidence concerns publishing a merchant's product/service catalog into agent-discovery surfaces via a feed or import API. Catalog/discovery feeds are a different product category (commerce catalog/search infrastructure) than agentic payment authorization, so this axis is a category error for this product.
